scope: Static source/retained assembly review only; no original or rebuilt DLL, game, native locale API, or provider invoked. Existing standalone validation inspected; no additional test execution performed.
checks: 0x18006f95d uses BL for the table index; character is truncated to 8 bits, including sign-extended parser bytes.
0x18006f960 tests DIL, so multibyte_mask is truncated to 8 bits; ctype_mask remains 32 bits against a zero-extended 16-bit table word.
Multibyte table access precedes the optional locale-info pointer and ctype word; matching multibyte flags or zero ctype_mask skip both ctype reads.
Locale update occurs once before table reads. The wrapper supplies locale=0, ctype_mask=0 and multibyte_mask=4.
PTD+0x3a8 is read and masked with 0xfffffffd after classification only when the returned flag is nonzero; no flag write for zero flag.
Result is normalized through EAX to 0 or 1. ParserEffects forwards signed input through uint32_t and then low-byte classification.
No inferred RAII/exception cleanup was added; provider failures escape before late flag clearing, outside recovered normal-flow claims.
All Address values are provider-owned tokens; live bounded locale/multibyte/PTD storage, synchronization, ownership and SEH remain required provider dependencies.
Synthetic tests cover all 256 byte values, high character and multibyte mask bits, ctype high-bit masks, short-circuit access order, noncanonical nonzero clear flag and failure before late cleanup.
limitations: Source reconstruction and fixture agreement do not establish original source identity, complete native locale reconstruction, native ABI compatibility, SEH equivalence, or full DLL equivalence.
